clue.text: Solitaire makes Margaret utterly bored

parts.note: Peg is a familiar pet form of the name Margaret

indicators.note: read as 'when uttered', so the word bored is to be taken by its spoken sound

parts.note: bored, said out loud, matches a plank of wood

explanation.surface: Someone finds a game of patience desperately dull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utterly' looks like an intensifier but means 'as spoken'. Solitaire here is the peg-jumping board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitaire is a one-player game played by jumping pegs across a holed wooden base.

clue.text: French novelist a priest has to throw out

parts.note: to oust is to expel

explanation.surface: A clergyman has to expel a French writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcel Proust was a French author, famous for In Search of Lost Time.

clue.text: Prepare to acquire the whole collection

definitions.meaning: on your marks, get ready
to obtain a complete set

explanation.definitionFit: The starter's call before 'go' means get ready; obtaining every item is getting the complete series.

clue.text: Elected to work with Maggie's predecessor

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
Ted Heath led the Conservatives before Margaret Thatcher

explanation.surface: Voted to collaborate with the man before Thatcher.
explanation.walkthrough: Maggie is Margaret Thatcher, British Prime Minister; Edward 'Ted' Heath preceded her as Tory leader.
explanation.definitionFit: To elect is to choose, and to opt is to make a choice.

clue.text: Intend to appear in torn clothing

indicators.note: the first word shows up inside the second

parts.note: rent means torn, as in a rent garment
to aim is to intend

explanation.surface: Plans to wear ripped garments.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an archaic word for clothes or garments.

clue.text: A former PM is in retirement, quite obviously

definitions.text: A former PM is in retirement, quite obviously

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the former premier's name with the S is read backwards

parts.note: Sir Robert Peel was a nineteenth-century British Prime Minister
is abbreviates to S, as in the contraction 's

explanation.surface: A retired prime minister is plainly taking it easy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retirement' turns PEELS round to SLEEP; the whole clue doubles as the definition, since someone retired for the night plainly is sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has retired to bed is unconscious in slumber, which is what the picture of a dozing ex-premier shows.

clue.text: I go in to take the place of a petitioner

indicators.note: the letter I goes into the middle of the other word

parts.note: to supplant is to replace someone, taking their place

explanation.surface: I enter to stand in for someone making a plea.
explanation.definitionFit: A suppliant is someone humbly begging, a petitioner.

clue.text: Curse a Devonshire flower-box

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon; a flower is something that flows
a crate is a box

explanation.surface: A gardener swears at a Devon window-box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is a crossword pun for a river, something that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: To execrate is to denounce or curse.

clue.text: Bliss is being in the procession

indicators.note: the little word is placed inside the longer one

parts.note: a parade is a procession

explanation.surface: Marching in a parade is joy itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradise means heaven, a state of perfect happiness or bliss.

clue.text: What the streaker does to leave the others standing

definitions.meaning: a streaker takes their clothes off and runs out, i.e. goes out and strips
to beat rivals easily by going faster than them

explanation.definitionFit: A streaker runs out after undressing, while to leave rivals standing is to surpass them by far.

clue.text: A very quiet listener, so it would seem

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
an ear is the organ one listens with

explanation.surface: A hushed audience member gives a certain impression.
explanation.definitionFit: To give the impression of being something is to look that way, a close synonym.

clue.text: One way to cool punch

definitions.meaning: to ... on hot food cools it
a hit with the fist

explanation.definitionFit: Puffing air on hot soup cools it, and a strike with the fist is a punch.

clue.text: Bon voyage, Veronica

definitions.meaning: a farewell wish that the traveller go fast and safely
Veronica is the botanical genus of small blue-flowered plants

explanation.definitionFit: A farewell 'God speed you well' wish; and the blue-flowered plant genus Veronica has that common name.

clue.text: Sensational cover about Sumerian centre

indicators.note: the covering word goes round, so it sits about the other piece

parts.note: a lid is a cover for a pot or box
Ur was a major city, a centre of ancient Sumerian civilisation

explanation.surface: A shocking exposé about an ancient Mesopotamian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Lurid describes something shocking or vividly sensational, like tabloid headlines.

clue.text: Notice a blemish

definitions.meaning: to notice is to catch sight of
a pimple or mark on the skin

explanation.definitionFit: To notice something is to see it; a small mark on the skin is a pimple or blemish.

clue.text: He sits in for an examiner

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
a tester examines things

explanation.surface: He stands in for an inspector.
explanation.walkthrough: A sit-in is a form of demonstration, so someone who sits in is a demonstrator.
explanation.definitionFit: A demonstrator who occupies a building in a sit-in is one who objects.

clue.text: The spectres generated by this war

indicators.note: the letters of the following words produce something new when rearranged

explanation.surface: Ghosts are the legacy of this conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: Wraiths are ghosts or apparitions, the same as spectres.

clue.text: Last, despite everything

definitions.meaning: following every other one
in spite of what has happened

explanation.definitionFit: Coming behind the others is coming last; the phrase also means nevertheless.

clue.text: Faux pas made by lingerie manufacturers

definitions.meaning: a blunder or embarrassing mistake
baggy knickers, a garment produced by underwear makers

explanation.definitionFit: A blunder is a howler, and old-fashioned baggy women's knickers share the same name.

clue.text: Disagree about the result of nuclear explosions

definitions.meaning: to quarrel with someone
radioactive dust that drifts down after a blast

explanation.definitionFit: Friends quarrel when they fall out; radioactive debris settling after a bomb is called fallout.

clue.text: Not everyone is upset by gin

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so read upwards

parts.note: part means some, not everyone

explanation.surface: Some people are bothered by gin.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin is a snare for catching animals.

clue.text: An obligation imposed by customs

definitions.meaning: a moral or legal responsibility
the tax that customs officers levy on imported goods

explanation.definitionFit: A responsibility one must fulfil, and a tax levied on imports at the border.

clue.text: Break up a group of Hell's Angels

definitions.meaning: to dissolve an organisation
a gang of bikers, cryptically Dis (Hell) plus a band

explanation.definitionFit: Dissolving an organisation breaks it up; a biker gang read as Hell's group is Dis's band.

clue.text: The French in heart-again!

parts.note: en is French for in
the core is the heart of something

explanation.surface: The French in heart cry again!
explanation.definitionFit: Audiences shout this word demanding a repeat performance.

clue.text: Port is passed round for a toast

indicators.note: being passed round mixes the letters of the words before

explanation.surface: Port circulates the dinner table for drinking healths.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosit is a German or Latin toast, meaning may it benefit you.

clue.text: Call out when the first lady is about to pass

indicators.note: the first lady's name surrounds the other piece, standing about it

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible
OK means to approve or pass something

explanation.surface: A shout goes up as the President's wife is about to go by.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke is to summon or call forth, as one calls up a memory or spirit.

clue.text: Jack Dyer is a non-voter

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, abbreviated AB for able seaman
a dyer stains fabric, so is a stainer

explanation.surface: A man called Jack Dyer declines to vote.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack Dyer reads as a person's name, but both words are common nouns here.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abstains from voting declines to cast a ballot.

clue.text: Unusually eager to concur

indicators.note: the letters of the next word arranged in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Uncharacteristically keen to go along with things.
explanation.definitionFit: To concur is to be of the same mind.

clue.text: Like to incorporate fellow negotiators

indicators.note: the first word takes the second into its body, so it contains it

parts.note: as means like, in a comparison
gent is short for gentleman, a fellow

explanation.surface: Similarly, a man is brought in to bargain.
explanation.definitionFit: Agents act on behalf of others, often bargaining as their representatives.

clue.text: Irishman is heartened by three nationalists

indicators.note: given a new heart, so the second piece goes into the middle of the first

parts.note: Pat is a stock Irish name; with is contracted to 's
a trio is a group of three

explanation.surface: An Irishman is cheered up by a group of three fervent nationalists.
explanation.definitionFit: Patriots are people devoted to their country, much like nationalists.

clue.text: Strong desire by soldiers to gain distinction

parts.note: lust is intense desire
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: Troops with burning ambition hope to win honours.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre can mean glory or renown, a distinction that shines.

clue.text: He supports a woman in the depression

indicators.note: the woman goes inside the hollow

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression in a surface
her is a pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A man props up a lady stuck in a ditch.
explanation.definitionFit: An adherent is a follower or supporter of a cause.
